title: Directional Trajectory Control by Employing Statistics and Probability Methods
text:
Abstract 
                   In accordance with the conception of regarding the drilling process of individual well as the reciprocal full scale simulation of others, this paper describes the processes to extract pertinent information for trajectory control from the database of accomplished wells and drilled sections. The references have been made to the successful application in a cluster-well engineering, in terms of H50 project, to validate the related methods.
